connector.name: Whale Data MCP
connector.registryDescription: Signed settled outcomes (Polymarket, sports, Kalshi) + whale signals as agent tools, paid via x402.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package whale-data-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the predgeai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Funded Base-mainnet key that signs USDC micropayments. Either this or SOLANA_BUYER_SECRET enables paid tools; the free discovery tool needs neither.

env.name: X402_NETWORK
env.description: x402 network: 'base' (mainnet, real USDC) or 'base-sepolia' (only against a testnet deployment).

env.name: MAX_PRICE_USD
env.description: Hard per-call price cap in USD. Calls priced above it are refused before any payment. Default 0.05.

env.name: PREDGE_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to the production deployment.

env.name: SOLANA_BUYER_SECRET
env.description: Funded Solana-mainnet key (64-number JSON array or base58) to also pay on Solana. Optional — either this or BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY enables paid tools.

env.name: X402_SOLANA_NETWORK
env.description: Solana network: 'solana' (mainnet) or 'solana-devnet'. Defaults to match X402_NETWORK's testnet-ness.

env.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
env.description: Optional custom Solana RPC (the public mainnet-beta endpoint is rate-limited).
